name: GammaRips
description: Nightly US market & options-flow intelligence MCP server for AI trading agents across US stocks, 2x/inverse single-stock ETFs, and liquid options. 9 MCP tools: 40–50 daily setups with mapped execution_vehicles (underlying_stock, long_2x_etfs, inverse_etfs, option_contract) and rv_iv_ratio (free 3-setup preview on /mcp), live 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, 3-day MFE/MAE move history, minute/daily price replay, VIX/VIX3M regime context, and playbooks. Also offers $1,000 5-day custom Python trading agent builds at https://gammarips.com/build. No shared daily pick endpoint. Educational market data only, not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Free tier (no key, no card): connect to https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp for the 3-contract pool preview (matching https://gammarips.com/signals), daily reports, methodology playbooks, regime context, and market calendar. Pro tier ($299/yr or $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after, 7-day free trial at https://gammarips.com/pricing): unlocks the full 40–50 contract daily Combo A dataset, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day outcome history via (1) OAuth 2.1 at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro or (2) 'Authorization: Bearer gr_live_...' API key generated at https://gammarips.com/account.

universe: about 3,500 optionable US stocks, filtered nightly to the top 100 liquid universe and bullish calls passing Combo A gates (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45)
